title: 1991 Bob Lazar video on gravity wave A and gravity wave B

tellings.quote: I saw a bizarre um video from 1991, which Joe Rogan pointed me to with this guy Bob Lazar seemingly talking nonsense.

plain: A 1991 video shows Bob Lazar, a man who has said he worked on recovered craft in Nevada, explaining two kinds of gravity he called gravity wave A and gravity wave B. The researcher Eric Weinstein says the podcaster Joe Rogan pointed him to it, and that at first it looked like "this guy Bob Lazar seemingly talking nonsense." He brings it up because, if the ideas meant something, Lazar would have been describing real physics behind such craft.
